text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no known antidote for KYXATA overdosage. The anticipated complications of overdosage would be secondary to bone marrow suppression and/or hepatic toxicity. Patients receiving overdosages of carboplatin experienced severe liver function test abnormalities. Loss of vision, which can be complete for light and colors, has been reported after the use of carboplatin at doses higher than the recommended approved dosage for KYXATA. Vision recovers totally or to a significant extent after discontinuation of carboplatin. Clinically significant hearing loss has been reported to occur in pediatric patients when carboplatin was administered at higher than approved recommended doses for KYXATA and in combination with other ototoxic agents [see Drug Interactions (7) ]. KYXATA is removed by dialysis. Closely monitor patients suspected of receiving an overdose, including for the adverse reactions described above, and administer appropriate supportive treatment.
